T: Every universe has a favourite snack.
D: Teenager Miles Morales becomes Spider-Man and meets spider-heroes from other universes.
P: Serve the snacks when Miles takes his leap of faith off the building.
S: green plantains shaved and fried crisp with lime, chilli and smoked salt, leap of faith

Green plantains shaved thin and fried crisp, tossed in lime, chilli and smoked salt, with a creamy pickled jalapeño and coriander dip. Peel 3 green plantains and slice very thin on a mandoline. Fry in batches at 175C for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp. Toss hot with the zest of 1 lime, half a tsp chilli powder and smoked salt. Blitz 150g sour cream with 3 tbsp pickled jalapeños, a handful of coriander and lime juice for the dip.
Puff pastry rolls with ham, pineapple and mozzarella. That's all folks.
Puff pastry spread with tomato, rolled up with ham, pineapple and mozzarella, then sliced into spirals and baked golden.
Chopped griddled beef and onion with American cheese in hero rolls, lettuce and tomato
Beef mince chopped on the griddle with onions and melted American cheese, stuffed into hero rolls with lettuce, tomato, ketchup and mayo.
M: Two smashed patties with bacon, onion rings and barbecue sauce
Double cheeseburger with crisp bacon, battered onion rings and barbecue sauce on a toasted bun, eaten in sweatpants.
tall stacks lightened with egg whites, bacon, butter, berries and maple syrup, safe house breakfast

Tall, fluffy buttermilk pancakes with whipped egg whites folded through, stacked with crispy bacon, salted butter, berries and warm maple syrup. Whisk 300g plain flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp bicarb and a pinch of salt. Mix 450ml buttermilk, 2 egg yolks and 50g melted butter, stir into the dry mix and rest 15 minutes. Whip 2 egg whites to soft peaks and fold through. Cook ladlefuls in butter over medium heat until bubbles set, then flip. Grill 8 bacon rashers. Stack with butter, berries, bacon and maple syrup.
W: Big brown butter chocolate chip cookies with soft middles and flaky salt
Brown butter choc chip cookie dough rested overnight, scooped big, baked at 180C for 11 minutes so the middles stay soft, flaky salt on top.
K: Chilled coconut milk, condensed milk and cinnamon drink, with no rum
Coconut milk, condensed milk and evaporated milk blended with cinnamon, nutmeg and vanilla, served ice cold in small glasses.

s.note: Puff pastry rolls with ham, pineapple and mozzarella. That's all folks.
s.how: Lay 2 sheets puff pastry flat and spread each with 1 tbsp tomato paste. Scatter with 150g chopped ham, 100g drained crushed pineapple and 120g grated mozzarella. Roll up tightly, slice into 2cm pinwheels and bake at 200C for 18 minutes.

s.note: Chopped griddled beef and onion with American cheese in hero rolls, lettuce and tomato
s.how: Fry 500g beef mince and 1 diced onion on a hot griddle, chopping it up with 2 spatulas, season well. Lay 8 slices American cheese over, let it melt and chop it through. Pile into 4 hero rolls with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, ketchup and mayo.

m.note: Two smashed patties with bacon, onion rings and barbecue sauce
m.how: Soak a thick-sliced onion in milk, dredge in flour and fry into rings. Grill 8 rashers of bacon. Smash 8 patties from 800g mince with American cheese. Stack two per toasted bun with bacon, onion rings and barbecue sauce.

w.note: Big brown butter chocolate chip cookies with soft middles and flaky salt
w.how: Brown 150g butter and cool. Beat with 200g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 250g flour, half a tsp bicarb and 200g choc chips. Rest overnight. Scoop 10 big balls and bake at 180C for 11 minutes so the middles stay soft. Add flaky salt.

d.note: Chilled coconut milk, condensed milk and cinnamon drink, with no rum
d.how: Blend 400ml coconut milk, 200ml sweetened condensed milk, 200ml evaporated milk, 1 tsp vanilla, 1/2 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg until smooth. Chill 2 hours and serve in 4 small glasses with a dusting of cinnamon.
